answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, thus paying the glacier bond on all of them and exposing each to the echo slash. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 2 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. Because the lotus audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. A 114 account operation therefore ties up 16 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
